name: slb_step_up_baseline_recalc_payment_dates
question_template: A sustainability-linked green bond with face value {FACE} USD is issued on 1 January 2026 and pays an annual coupon of {COUPON} percent of face on 31 December of each year from 2026 through {MATURITY_YEAR} inclusive; ignore principal and all other cash flows. Baseline-year emissions are {BASELINE} tons CO2e. Before the observation period the issuer divests a unit accounting for {DIVEST_SHARE} percent of baseline-year emissions. The framework recalculates the baseline by removing that share only when the divested share is at least 5 percent; otherwise the original baseline stands. The performance target is emissions no higher than the applicable baseline reduced by {TARGET_CUT} percent. Verified emissions for calendar year 2027 equal {OBSERVED_PCT} percent of the original baseline, and the verification date is 30 June 2028. If verified emissions exceed the target by more than 5 percent of the target, the coupon rate steps up by {STEP_UP} basis points; if they exceed it by at most 5 percent of the target, the step-up is half that; if they are at or below the target there is no step-up. Any step-up applies to every coupon paid on or after the verification date through maturity, and earlier coupons are unaffected. Compute the total coupon cash paid over the bond's life.

slots.description: Baseline emissions after applying the recalculation rule.
Target emissions level derived from the applicable baseline.
Annual coupon rate applying to coupons paid after verification.
Number of coupon payments subject to any step-up.

program:
def solve():
    face = Fraction(P["FACE"])
    c = Fraction(P["COUPON"])
    mat = int(P["MATURITY_YEAR"])
    n_total = mat - 2025
    n_step = mat - 2027
    base = Fraction(P["BASELINE"])
    d = Fraction(P["DIVEST_SHARE"])
    cut = Fraction(P["TARGET_CUT"])
    obs_pct = Fraction(P["OBSERVED_PCT"])
    su = Fraction(P["STEP_UP"])
    if d >= 5:
        app = base * (1 - d / 100)
    else:
        app = base
    thr = app * (1 - cut / 100)
    obs = base * obs_pct / 100
    if obs <= thr:
        add_bp = Fraction(0)
    elif obs <= thr * Fraction(105, 100):
        add_bp = su / 2
    else:
        add_bp = su
    step_rate = c + add_bp / 100
    total = face * (c / 100 * (n_total - n_step) + step_rate / 100 * n_step)
    return {
        "final": total,
        "applicable_baseline": app,
        "emissions_threshold": thr,
        "stepped_coupon_rate": step_rate,
        "stepped_coupon_count": Fraction(n_step),
    }
